name: @broomva/scroll-cinema
description: Scroll-driven cinematic video scrubbing: two decoders, bounded memory, frame-rate-independent easing.

scripts.demo:build: bun build demo/main.ts --outdir demo/dist --entry-naming demo.js --target browser
scripts.dogfood: bun run demo:build && node scripts/dogfood.mjs && node scripts/dogfood.mjs --stream
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.cinema:demo: node pipeline/cinema.mjs build pipeline/storyboard.example.json --out .cinema-demo --provider mock && node pipeline/cinema.mjs verify .cinema-demo
